messages:
elaine: Quick UX probe — when switching per-route filters in Console, telemetry charts jump and quota preview resets. Is debounce + optimistic cached saved-query the right approach? cc @michael @jess

michael: I think debounce helps, but root cause is the API returning no 'stable_query_id' until save completes. We should extend savedQueries API to return provisional id immediately. Example contract: 
```
POST /saved_queries -> { provisional_id: 'tmp_123', status: 'pending' }
```

jess: Concern: provisional IDs + telemetry sampling could double count in some reports (we aggregate by query id). Need mapping layer that collapses provisional->final on ingest or in frontend telemetry join. Ops flagged this before.

pavel: From infra side, collapsing in ingestion is costly. Prefer the frontend to emit final mapping event when save completes. That avoids re-ingestion.

elaine: Frontend emitting mapping event works for Console, but routes used by SDK/customers won't emit. Can we add a server-side reconciliation job that remaps provisional ids -> final for telemetry backfills? Low priority but useful.

michael: Proposal: API returns provisional_id; Console sends `saved_query_resolved` event with { provisional_id, final_id } to telemetry collector. We add a short-lived mapping cache in the router (< 24h) + reconcile batch job for anything older.

tara: UX note: show transient "Unsaved filter" badge and allow "Apply without saving" that doesn't create an ID so no telemetry churn. Also add "Save & pin" CTA that does provisional->final flow.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary rollout for saved_queries v2 started on 'console' cluster — 12% traffic. /deploy/172001

jess: Also, quota preview must use user's view (not provisional ids) — implement deterministic cost calc based on filter payload rather than query id while provisional.

elaine: Agreed. Next steps: michael to draft API PR for provisional id + mapping event; pavel to sketch reconciliation job cost; tara to mock badge copy. I'll sync up Tuesday. :thumbsup:
